free_tier.stated: Free, no signup and no API key; files up to 500 MB, expiring after a chosen 1 second to 7 days.

retention.stated: chosen expiry from 1 second to 7 days; 604800 seconds maximum

egress.terms: No download volume or speed figure is published on the pages read.

interface_detail: POST /send with a multipart form (file and expire in seconds); the response is a 302 with the share URL in Location.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; the same form the home page uses.
chaining: The anonymous upload is a single curl POST; the share link can also delete the file.
binding_note: A 500 MB ceiling and a 7-day maximum clock make this a hand-off drop and not storage.

identity_cost.detail: No signup, no JavaScript and no API key are needed; the site states it is funded by its administrator.

reliability_note: Anyone with the share link can delete the file from its download page.
confidence_note: Cap and expiry read on the vendor llms.txt page.

evidence.quote: There is no signup, no JavaScript requirement, and no API key.
evidence.proved: no account or key is needed

evidence.quote: No ads. No sign up or registration required. Funded by the site administrator as a public service.

notes: The vendor llms.txt states 500 MB per file; an aggregator list shows 2 GB, which the vendor pages do not state.
